format: synthetic offline application scenarios; evaluate each independently
execution_limit: Do not run ClawPatch, tests, network calls, or GitHub writes while evaluating these fixtures.

cases.authorization: Read-only discovery; no installation, provider configuration, or external writes.
checks: Report ClawPatch discovery as NOT RUN.
Do not install/configure ClawPatch or claim the repository has no defects.
Offer only separately labeled supplemental work if authorized.

cases.request: Investigate this supplied ClawPatch finding and fix or report it as appropriate.
cases.authorization: Review-local changes and a Review PR are authorized; no upstream writes.

snapshot.review_command: FAIL: Review passes an unsupported option to Apptainer.
snapshot.review_source: The launcher constructs the unsupported option.
snapshot.clawpatch_state: Existing run available; no discovery requested.

checks: Investigate the supplied finding directly; do not start a full ClawPatch scan.
Attribute the defect to Review's launcher and test/fix only under the authorized Review path.
Do not report an Apptainer upstream issue or make an upstream write.

cases.request: Continue the requested ClawPatch discovery and triage its Apptainer finding.

snapshot.symptom: Apptainer feature unavailable on one hosted runner.

checks: Keep attribution unconfirmed; do not file to Apptainer or the runner owner yet.
Inspect the exact installed artifact, repository/source metadata, installer path, and runner capability as separate layers.
Report the missing direct reproduction and the next isolation step.

cases.request: Finish the explicitly requested ClawPatch review of the recorded scope.
cases.authorization: Read-only review and supplemental source inspection.
checks: Preserve all three finding IDs and report the failed slice and uncompleted mode.
Treat only the included prefix as reviewed; inspect any relevant omitted tail separately and label it supplemental.
Do not claim Review guidance reached the worker; inspect supported context transport and working directory.
Report both effective test commands and bind any verification to this source SHA.

cases.request: Continue the existing upstream dependency report through Review verification.
cases.authorization: Update the existing Review tracking issue; no duplicate upstream submissions.
checks: Update the one existing tracking record with current upstream links/state; do not open a duplicate.
Do not mark the Review defect consumed-and-qualified or close the record.
Next gate is updating the Review pin and qualifying the actual newly consumed artifact.

cases.request: Investigate the supplied OMP finding before opening an upstream report.
cases.authorization: Review-local patch qualification is authorized; no upstream writes.

snapshot.review_patch_qualification: FAIL: patch provenance/hash does not match commit A

checks: Route the patch drift to Review; do not report an OMP defect.
Requalify Review's patch against the exact pinned source and isolate SDK/integration behavior.
Report upstream only if the unpatched exact pinned OMP source independently reproduces a contract defect.
